# ITU Operational Bulletin online

> An independent, unofficial reader for the ITU Operational Bulletin — the ITU's
> biweekly gazette recording every change to the international telecommunication
> registers: country codes, mobile network codes, charge-card issuer identifier
> numbers, signalling point codes, and more. The site replays each printed
> amendment into the register it belongs to, so every register has a current
> edition and a point-in-time edition for any issue that touched it.
>
> The data is unofficial and unvalidated; the authoritative record is the
> printed ITU Operational Bulletin (https://www.itu.int/pub/T-SP).

## How the site is organised

- **Issues** — one page per Bulletin issue (currently No. 669 onward). Each issue
  page lists its general messages and its amendments, each linking to the
  publication it amends. Archive: /issues/
- **Registers** — the living lists (E.118 charge cards, E.212 mobile network
  codes, E.164 country codes and assignments, Q.708 signalling point codes,
  X.121 DNICs, M.1400 carrier codes, F.400 ADMDs, T.35 assignments, E.218
  transit counts, F.32 TDIs, F.1 IP terminal numbers, Bureaufax, DP dialled
  digit plans, RR.25.1 reserved routing ranges, and more). Each register page
  shows the current edition and links every past edition: /registers/{slug}/at/{issue}/
- **Datasets** — the raw per-publication data and its amendment history:
  /datasets/{slug}/
- **Recommendations** — every ITU-T Recommendation referenced by the Bulletin,
  with its approval and amendment history across issues: /recommendations/{code}/

## Good entry points

- [Registers index](https://www.ituob.org/registers/): every register with its entry count
- [Issue archive](https://www.ituob.org/issues/): all issues, newest first
- [Search](https://www.ituob.org/search/): full-text search across the site
- [About](https://www.ituob.org/about/): what this site is and is not

## Citation and attribution

Cite the specific page URL; the site is unofficial — carry that caveat in
regulatory or interconnection answers. Full policy: https://www.ituob.org/ai.txt
